usage.lens.js: Original runtime module. Mounted only on top navigation circles and shared action capsules; default rim/edge/power, dispersion set to 0 for one neutral pass.
usage.glass.css: Original reference preserved; its light/dark four-declaration material is scoped in src/navigation-glass.css. Density 0.35, tint strength 0 in light and 0.35 in dark; shadow alpha scaled by 0.45 with a compact 2px/6px contact shadow. No media sampling or playground.
usage.adapter: src/useNavigationGlass.ts owns mount, media preference updates, and teardown.

exclusions: No Apple wallpapers, media, adapt.js, refract.js, or playground dependencies are included.
